reason: Article 26 of the DORA Delegated Regulation requires ICT third-party risk management, which includes testing business continuity plans. The requirement to test 'at least once a year' and consider 'severe but plausible scenarios' is a standard and logical interpretation of the testing obligation within this article.

Article 11(6) of the DORA Regulation pertains to the content of the ICT risk management framework, specifically the requirement to identify and assess risks. It does not contain any provisions related to the testing of business continuity plans.
